components.explanation: Eight thin scene files; levels share game.gd and differ only by an exported level_id.
game.gd builds the whole arena at runtime: layers, geometry, gate, spotlights, nests, pipes, player, camera and HUD.
Arenas are dictionaries in _get_level_config: width, spawn rate, cap, chicken health, pipes, spotlights, platforms, eggs.
GameState registers every keyboard, mouse and joypad action into the InputMap at boot.
player.gd: movement, jump buffer, coyote time, double jump, drop-through, jetpack, aiming and weapon signals.
bullet.gd (Area2D ball) and grenade.gd (RigidBody2D with a 3-blink fuse).
hit_flash.gdshader: one tint uniform for the palette colour, one flash uniform for the hit flash.
pipe.gd recolours itself and requests a chicken; chicken.gd walks, hops, flies, takes knockback and dies.
_on_chicken_died and _resolve_death_window: three or more deaths before the next physics frame.
_check_chicken_contacts and _player_hit: a 58 px distance check, health, lives and respawn.
_check_eggs: 62 px pickup, a backwards loop, and the win condition.
intro_briefing.gd: typed dialogue; its full-screen shade ColorRect swallows clicks (defect D-01).
_build_ui and _make_bar: the HUD; bars sized before show_percentage is off measure 34 px tall (defect D-02).
main_menu.gd (Play, Continue, How to Play, Quit), instructions.gd, and end_screen.gd serving victory and defeat via an exported mode.
GameState autoload (campaign totals, theme, widgets) plus project, bus layout and export settings.
Audio autoload: 13 named sounds, 16 pooled voices, looping music; 14 synthesized .wav files.
effects.gd: static helpers for feathers, splatter, ball hits, dust, explosions, sparkles and floating text; spotlight.gd swings the lamps.
Textures, sprite frames, fonts and sounds, reused from the Unity project or synthesized; six images and one font are never used.

func _configure_input() -> void:
	_add_keys("move_left", [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT])
	_add_keys("move_right", [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT])
	_add_keys("move_down", [KEY_S, KEY_DOWN])
	_add_keys("jump", [KEY_SPACE, KEY_W, KEY_UP])
	_add_keys("fire", [KEY_F, KEY_J])
	_add_keys("grenade", [KEY_G, KEY_E])
	_add_keys("jetpack", [KEY_SHIFT])
	_add_keys("pause", [KEY_ESCAPE, KEY_P])
	_add_keys("restart", [KEY_R])

	_add_mouse("fire", MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
	_add_mouse("grenade", MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT)

func _on_chicken_died(chicken: CharacterBody2D) -> void:
	var at := chicken.global_position
	Fx.feathers(effects, at, chicken.tint)
	Fx.splatter(decals, at + Vector2(0, 10))
	kills += 1
	deaths_this_window += 1
	if not death_window_open:
		death_window_open = true
		_resolve_death_window.call_deferred(at)

func _resolve_death_window(at: Vector2) -> void:
	# Unity AudioManager.DeathWindowRoutine: three or more deaths in one frame earn a megakill.
	await get_tree().physics_frame
	if deaths_this_window >= MEGA_KILL_AMOUNT:
		Audio.play("megakill")
		Fx.floating_text(effects, at + Vector2(0, -50), "MEGA KILL!", GameState.LIME, 46)
		_shake(10.0)
	Audio.play("splat")
	deaths_this_window = 0
	death_window_open = false

func _make_bar(at: Vector2, bar_size: Vector2, fill: Color) -> ProgressBar:
	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
	bar.position = at
	bar.size = bar_size
	bar.show_percentage = false
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", GameState.panel_style(Color(0.02, 0.08, 0.14, 0.9), GameState.INK, 5, 1))
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", GameState.panel_style(fill, Color.TRANSPARENT, 5, 0))
	return bar

code_result_pairs.observation: Arena 1 appears fully built from the 7-line scene: backdrop, platforms, pipes, spotlights, nests, player, HUD.
Arena 3 shows 4 pipes, the 38 % navy tint and a top platform row, matching the dictionary.
Joypad events drive move, aim, fire, jump and pause through the code-registered actions.
Space jumps; a second Space in mid-air re-launches upward (asserted: velocity jumped by more than 200).
Holding Shift lifts the player and drains the fuel bar (asserted: fuel below 1.0).
Held left click fires basketballs toward the crosshair at a steady rate with muzzle flash and recoil.
Right-click lobs a grenade that bounces, blinks three times and explodes about 3 s later.
Chickens appear in several palette tints; hit chickens flash white briefly.
A grenade kills four chickens in one window: MEGA KILL! and the kill counter jumps 0 to 4.
Three contacts cost three health balls and a life; fade and respawn at the gate follow.
Nests are collected with sparkle and +1 EGG; the fifth shows COURT CLEARED!
Two clicks do not advance the briefing (asserted); Enter does.
Zoomed engine frames: the grenade and fuel bars cover the lower part of their hint labels.
